metadata.proof: GET /api/admin/exports/decisions (line 1534) writes borrower_summary directly into a CSV row via csv.DictWriter at line 1552. The borrower_summary field originates from DecisionIn.borrower_summary (max 5000 chars) set via POST /api/applications/{id}/decisions by an admin or underwriter. CSV formula injection occurs because values starting with =, +, -, @ are not sanitized — when the CSV is opened in Excel/Sheets, a malicious underwriter can execute formulas interpreted by the admin who exports the file.
